name: svg-french-press-glm-5.3-flashx-v2-s3-r4
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 900" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfe3ee"/>
      <stop offset="0.2" stop-color="#eef7fb"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#bcd6e4"/>
      <stop offset="0.8" stop-color="#eef7fb"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#cfe3ee"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8f979e"/>
      <stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#e8ecef"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#aab3ba"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#788088"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="steelv" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8ecef"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#9aa3ab"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c8cfd5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="brew" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6b4326"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#3c2413"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="knob" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2b2b2b"/>
      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#5a5a5a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#222"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect width="600" height="900" fill="#f7f4ef"/>
  <text x="300" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" letter-spacing="4" fill="#3a3a3a">FRENCH PRESS</text>
  <text x="300" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" letter-spacing="2" fill="#8a8578">EXPLODED ASSEMBLY DIAGRAM</text>

  <!-- center axis -->
  <line x1="300" y1="110" x2="300" y2="850" stroke="#b9b2a4" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="10 6 2 6"/>

  <!-- 1 KNOB -->
  <g transform="translate(0,-25)">
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="130" rx="34" ry="22" fill="url(#knob)"/>
    <ellipse cx="290" cy="124" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#6e6e6e" opacity="0.7"/>
    <rect x="288" y="140" width="24" height="18" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <text x="380" y="132" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a">1 · Knob (bakelite)</text>
    <line x1="338" y1="128" x2="372" y2="128" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 2 PLUNGER ROD -->
  <g transform="translate(0,-25)">
    <rect x="293" y="160" width="14" height="180" rx="4" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <rect x="289" y="330" width="22" height="16" rx="3" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <text x="380" y="250" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a">2 · Plunger rod (stainless)</text>
    <line x1="310" y1="248" x2="372" y2="248" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 3 THREE-PIECE FILTER ASSEMBLY, exploded along the rod axis -->
  <!-- 3a spring coil -->
  <g transform="translate(0,-25)">
    <path d="M262 384 q38 -26 76 0 q-38 26 -76 0 Z" fill="none" stroke="#8a939b" stroke-width="5"/>
    <path d="M262 384 q38 26 76 0" fill="none" stroke="#b9c1c8" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M262 384 q38 -26 76 0 M262 392 q38 -26 76 0 M262 400 q38 -26 76 0" fill="none" stroke="#7d868e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="380" y="392" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a">3a · Spring coil</text>
    <line x1="342" y1="390" x2="372" y2="390" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <!-- 3b cross / pressure plate -->
  <g transform="translate(0,-25)">
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="440" rx="78" ry="16" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="436" rx="78" ry="16" fill="#d5dbe0"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="436" rx="78" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#7c848c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="222" y="430" width="156" height="8" fill="#c3cad0" opacity="0.5"/>
    <text x="380" y="440" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a">3b · Cross plate</text>
    <line x1="382" y1="436" x2="372" y2="436" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <!-- 3c mesh screen -->
  <g transform="translate(0,-25)">
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="496" rx="80" ry="17" fill="url(#steelv)"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="492" rx="80" ry="17" fill="#cdd4da" stroke="#7c848c" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <g stroke="#8b949c" stroke-width="0.7">
      <path d="M224 490 h152 M224 494 h152 M226 486 h148 M232 482 h136"/>
      <path d="M240 478 v28 M255 476 v32 M270 474 v36 M285 473 v38 M300 473 v38 M315 473 v38 M330 474 v36 M345 476 v32 M360 478 v28"/>
    </g>
    <text x="405" y="478" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a">3c · Mesh screen</text>
    <line x1="384" y1="467" x2="398" y2="467" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 4 LID -->
  <g transform="translate(0,-5)">
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="580" rx="110" ry="24" fill="#b8bfc6"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="572" rx="110" ry="24" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#757d85" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="570" rx="44" ry="9" fill="#9aa3ab" stroke="#7c848c"/>
    <text x="440" y="576" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a">4 · Lid</text>
    <line x1="408" y1="572" x2="432" y2="572" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 5 BEAKER with handle, spout and coffee -->
  <g>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M398 660 q70 10 66 70 q-4 56 -70 62" fill="none" stroke="url(#steel)" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <path d="M205 630 L205 800 q0 60 95 60 q95 0 95 -60 L395 630 Z" fill="url(#glass)" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- coffee -->
    <path d="M209 686 L209 798 q0 56 91 56 q91 0 91 -56 L391 686 q-60 16 -91 16 q-31 0 -91 -16 Z" fill="url(#brew)" opacity="0.92"/>
    <!-- glass highlights -->
    <path d="M222 645 L222 790" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" opacity="0.45" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M380 650 L380 795" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- rim -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="630" rx="95" ry="20" fill="#e8f2f7" opacity="0.6" stroke="#a9c4d2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M215 622 q-22 -14 -14 -26 q6 -8 26 4" fill="#dceaf2" stroke="#a9c4d2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- base -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="858" rx="70" ry="10" fill="#d9dee2" stroke="#aab3ba"/>
    <text x="150" y="838" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a" text-anchor="end">5 · Carafe (glass)</text>
    <line x1="156" y1="834" x2="226" y2="834" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 6 FRAME / cage -->
  <g>
    <path d="M212 618 L212 812" stroke="url(#steel)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M388 618 L388 812" stroke="url(#steel)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M212 812 q88 34 176 0" fill="none" stroke="url(#steel)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M212 618 q-10 -14 -6 -24 M388 618 q10 -14 6 -24" fill="none" stroke="#8a939b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="100" y="770" font-size="14" fill="#4a4a4a" text-anchor="end">6 · Frame</text>
    <line x1="106" y1="766" x2="200" y2="766" stroke="#9a9284" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <text x="300" y="888" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" letter-spacing="1.5" fill="#a09a8c">ASSEMBLE IN NUMERIC ORDER · STANDARD THREE-PIECE PLUNGER FILTER (3a–3c)</text>
</svg>
